description: Get all active weather alerts issued by the Norwegian Meteorological Institute for Norway. Alerts cover events such as gale, storm, heavy rain, snow, ice, avalanche, and fog. Each alert includes event type, awareness level (green/yellow/orange/red), severity, certainty, affected counties, description, consequences, and valid time interval. Filter by event type slug (wind, rain, snow, ice, fog, avalanche) or by county name. Returns English or Norwegian text. CC BY 4.0 + NLOD 2.0, no auth, no upstream cost.

county.description: Filter alerts by Norwegian county name substring (e.g. "Oslo", "Viken", "Troms"). Case-insensitive partial match.

event_type.description: Filter by event type slug (e.g. "wind", "rain", "snow", "ice", "fog", "avalanche"). Leave empty for all active alerts.

lang.description: Language for alert text. "en" = English (default), "no" = Norwegian.

name: metno.weather.alerts

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: MET Norway — Active Weather Alerts
